mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalPopList */ SELECT C.COM_CODE, /* 고객사코드 */ C.COM_NAME_LOC, /* 회사명(국문) */ C.COM_NAME_ENG, /* 회사명(영문) */ C.IRS_NO, /* 사업자등록번호 */ C.ESTABLISH_DATE, /* 설립년도 */ C.CEO_NAME_LOC, /* 대표자(국문) */ C.CEO_NAME_ENG, /* 대표자(영문) */ C.TEL_NO, /* 대표자전화번호 */ C.FAX_NO, /* 대표자FAX번호 */ C.INDUSTRY_TYPE, /* 업태 */ C.BUSINESS_ITEMS, /* 종목 */ C.ZIP_CODE, /* 우편번호 */ nvl(C.MAIL_SEND_FLAG,'N') AS MAIL_SEND_FLAG, /* 메일링서비스 */ C.ADDRESS_LOC, /* 주소(국문) */ C.ADDRESS_ENG, /* 주소(영문) */ C.ZIP_KEY, /* 도로명주소 키 */ NVL(C.ADDRESS_LOC1, C.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC1, /* 도로명주소 */ C.ADDRESS_LOC2, /* 도로명주소 상세주소 */ C.HP_ADDRESS, /* 홈페이지주소 */ nvl(C.CORP_REG_NO,'') AS CORP_REG_NO, /* 법인등록번호 */ C.TRADE_REG_NO, /* 무역업등록번호 */ C.DUNS_NO, /* DUNS-NO */ C.CREDIT_RATING, /* 신용등급 */ C.GR_EMP_NM, /* 입고담당자명 */ C.GR_EMP_TEL, /* 입고담당자연락처 */ C.AC_EMP_NM, /* 경리담당자명 */ C.AC_EMP_TEL, /* 경리담당자연락처 */ C.PAY_RECVER, /* 물품대금 수령처 */ E.PAY_TERMS, /* 수금조건 */ E.PAY_TYPE, /* 수금형태 */ NVL(C.CAR_FLAG,'N') AS CAR_FLAG, /* 차량정보입력 */ C.CONTRACT_EXPIRE_DATE, /* 계약만료일 */ C.CONTRACT_AUTO_RENEW, /* 자동연장여부 */ (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M103' AND CODE = C.KEP_BUSINESS_ITEM) AS KEP_BUSINESS_ITEM_TEXT, /* 회원사업종명 */ C.KEP_BUSINESS_ITEM AS KEP_BUSINESS_ITEM, /* 회원사업종코드 */ C.CAR_DELIV_CNT, /* 차량일배송횟수 */ C.IMAGE_KEY, /* 첨부파일 */ (SELECT SRC_FILE_NAME FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = C.IMAGE_KEY AND ROWNUM = 1) AS IMAGE_KEY_TEXT, /* 첨부파일 */ C.INCOME_PRICE_OPEN_FLAG, /* 매입단가오픈여부 */ C.DUEDATE_FLAG, /* 납기일구분 */ C.SAP_CODE, /* SAP코드 */ C.CORP_CODE, /* 법인그룹코드 */ (SELECT CORP_NAME FROM BNTBUYERGROUP A WHERE A.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE) AS CORP_NAME, /* 법인그룹명 */ C.SMS_RECV_FLAG, /* SMS수신여부 */ C.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG, /* 협력사공개여부 */ C.BUDGET_FLAG, /* 예산관리여부 */ C.LOGO_YN, /* 로고사용여부 */ C.DS_FLAG, /* 납품수량변경유무 */ C.WAREHOUSE_CODE, /* 물류센터 */ C.REMARK, /* 비고 */ C.STATUS, /* 현재상태 */ nvl(D.RCPT_PO_FLAG,'N') AS RCPT_PO_FLAG, /* 접수발주여부 */ nvl(D.FEE_BASE_FLAG,'N') AS FEE_BASE_FLAG, /* FEE방법거래여부 */ nvl(D.MNG_NO_FLAG,'N') AS MNG_NO_FLAG, /* 관리번호사용여부 */ nvl(D.MNG_NO_POPUP_FLAG,'N') AS MNG_NO_POPUP_FLAG, /* 관리번호팝업사용여부 */ nvl(D.OFFICE_CATLG_FLAG,'N') AS OFFICE_CATLG_FLAG, /* 사무용품카탈로그사용여부 */ nvl(D.BUYER_CATLG_EDIT_FLAG,'N') AS BUYER_CATLG_EDIT_FLAG, /* 고객사카탈로그정비불가여부 */ nvl(D.QUOTATAION_EDIT_FLAG,'N') AS QUOTATAION_EDIT_FLAG, /* 견적제출수정가능여부 */ nvl(D.NEW_ITEM_PM_FLAG,'N') AS NEW_ITEM_PM_FLAG, /* 신규상품견적의뢰결재상신여부 */ nvl(D.EXIST_ACT_FLAG,'N') AS EXIST_ACT_FLAG, /* 삭제-기존매입대응불가여부 */ nvl(D.AUTO_CONFIRM_FLAG,'N') AS AUTO_CONFIRM_FLAG, /* 자동단가합의여부 */ nvl(D.QUOTATAION_BATCH_FLAG,'N') AS QUOTATAION_BATCH_FLAG, /* 견적일괄제출여부 */ nvl(D.PRICE_CONFIRM_ELCTR_FLAG,'N') AS PRICE_CONFIRM_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 단가합의전자결재여부 */ nvl(D.STEP2_PRICE_FLAG,'N') AS STEP2_PRICE_FLAG, /* 2단계단가협의여부 */ nvl(D.PRICE_CONFIRM_REPL_FLAG,'N') AS PRICE_CONFIRM_REPL_FLAG, /* 견적단가협의대행등록가능여부 */ nvl(D.ORDER_CONFIRM_FLAG,'N') AS ORDER_CONFIRM_FLAG, /* 2단계주문확정여부 */ nvl(D.ORDER_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG,'N') AS ORDER_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 주문부서전자결재여부 */ nvl(D.REQUEST_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG,'N') AS REQUEST_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 의뢰부서전자결재여부 */ nvl(D.GR_REGIST_FLAG,'N') AS GR_REGIST_FLAG, /* 입고대행등록가능여부 */ nvl(D.AUTO_GR_FLAG,'N') AS AUTO_GR_FLAG, /* 삭제-자동입고여부 */ nvl(D.STD_DATE_FLAG,'N') AS STD_DATE_FLAG, /* 표준납기관리여부 */ nvl(D.MULTI_QUOTATION_FLAG,'N') AS MULTI_QUOTATION_FLAG, /* 복수협력사견적필수여부 */ nvl(D.STD_INVOICE_FLAG,'N') AS STD_INVOICE_FLAG, /* kep표준거래명세서사용여부 */ nvl(D.FIVE_CATEG_FLAG,'N') AS FIVE_CATEG_FLAG, /* 5단계카테고리 */ nvl(D.VAT_FLAG,'N') AS VAT_FLAG, /* 부가세포함여부 */ nvl(D.CORP_REGIST_FLAG,'N') AS CORP_REGIST_FLAG, /* 법인등기부등록증 여부 */ nvl(D.SEAL_CERTI_REGIST_FLAG,'N') AS SEAL_CERTI_REGIST_FLAG, /* 인감증명서 여부 */ nvl(D.USE_SEAL_REGIST_FLAG,'N') AS USE_SEAL_REGIST_FLAG, /* 사용인감 여부 */ nvl(D.CONTRACT_REGIST_FLAG,'N') AS CONTRACT_REGIST_FLAG, /* 계약서여부 */ A.USER_ID, /* 사용자ID */ B.PASSWORD AS USER_PWD, /* 사용자PW */ 'N' AS CHKPASSWORD, B.USER_NAME_LOC, /* 사용자이름(국문) */ B.USER_NAME_ENG, /* 사용자이름(영문) */ B.EMAIL, /* 사용자EMAIL */ B.MOBILE_PHONE, /* 사용자핸드폰 */ B.PHONE_NUMBER, /* 사용자전화번호 */ B.FAX_NUMBER, /* 사용자FAX */ NVL(F.FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SYSDATE), 'YYYY/MM')) AS FROM_DATE, NVL(F.TO_DATE, '2999/12') AS TO_DATE, F.RATE, NVL(F.RATE_GUBUN, 'S') AS RATE_GUBUN, NVL(F.CONTRACT_FLAG, 'N') AS CONTRACT_FLAG, F.RATE_EDIT_FLAG, C.DELY_AREA, C.PROCESS_TYPE, C.SELL_CLOSE_DATE, C.RE_NOTE FROM ICOMCMPY C LEFT OUTER JOIN KEP_BUYER_FLAG D ON C.COM_CODE = D.COM_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ACNTBUYR E ON C.COM_CODE = E.BUYER LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE WHERE BUYER = #{com_code} AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')) F ON C.COM_CODE = F.BUYER , (SELECT USER_ID FROM (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND USER_TYPE = 'A' AND STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY BEGIN_DATE) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) A , ICOMLUSR B WHERE C.COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID

/* selectMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalChargeEntryList */ SELECT MS.BUYER AS COM_CODE, DECODE(MS.PRIORITY, 'Y', '1', '0') AS PRIORITY, MS.YEAR, MS.YEAR AS YEAR_ORG, MS.KEP_DEPT, MS.KEP_DEPT AS KEP_DEPT_ORG, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = MS.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NM, MS.POSITION_GROUP, MS.POSITION_GROUP AS POSITION_GROUP_ORG, MS.KEP_USER_ID, MS.KEP_USER_ID AS KEP_USER_ID_ORG, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=MS.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_NAME, MS.ITEM_GROUP, MS.PRIORITY AS PRIORITY_YN, MS.MAIN_CLERK AS MAIN_CLERK_YN FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MS WHERE MS.BUYER = #{com_code} AND MS.STATUS IN ('C') AND MS.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MS.POSITION_GROUP <> 'PA'
ORDER BY MS.YEAR, SEQ
/* selectMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalPopKepBuyerFlagCnt */ SELECT COUNT(COM_CODE) AS CNT FROM KEP_BUYER_FLAG WHERE COM_CODE = #{com_code}
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM ACNTBUYR WHERE BUYER = #{com_code}

/* selectMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalWarehouseCode */ SELECT A.TEXT1 AS CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.TEXT1) AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 A WHERE A.TYPE = 'HUB' AND FLAG = 'Y'
mapper.update: /*updateMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalPop2*/ UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET USER_NAME_LOC = #{st_user_name_loc}, USER_NAME_ENG = #{st_user_name_eng}, EMAIL = #{st_email}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{st_phone_number}, FAX_NUMBER = #{st_user_fax_no}, MOBILE_PHONE = #{st_mobile_phone} WHERE COM_CODE = #{com_code} AND USER_ID = UPPER(#{buyer_user_id})

/*updateMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalKepBuyerFlag*/ UPDATE KEP_BUYER_FLAG SET RCPT_PO_FLAG = #{st_rcpt_po_flag}, /* 접수발주여부 */ FEE_BASE_FLAG = #{st_fee_base_flag}, /* FEE방법거래여부 */ MNG_NO_FLAG = #{st_mng_no_flag}, /* 관리번호사용여부 */ MNG_NO_POPUP_FLAG = #{st_mng_no_popup_flag}, /* 관리번호팝업사용여부 */ OFFICE_CATLG_FLAG = #{st_office_catlg_flag}, /* 사무용품카탈로그사용여부 */ BUYER_CATLG_EDIT_FLAG = #{st_buyer_catlg_edit_flag}, /* 고객사카탈로그정비불가여부 */ QUOTATAION_EDIT_FLAG = #{st_quotataion_edit_flag}, /* 견적제출수정가능여부 */ NEW_ITEM_PM_FLAG = #{st_new_item_pm_flag}, /* 신규상품견적의뢰결재상신여부 */ EXIST_ACT_FLAG = #{st_exist_act_flag}, /* 삭제-기존매입대응불가여부 */ AUTO_CONFIRM_FLAG = #{st_auto_confirm_flag}, /* 자동단가합의여부 */ QUOTATAION_BATCH_FLAG = #{st_quotataion_batch_flag}, /* 견적일괄제출여부 */ PRICE_CONFIRM_ELCTR_FLAG = #{st_price_confirm_elctr_flag}, /* 단가합의전자결재여부 */ STEP2_PRICE_FLAG = #{st_step2_price_flag}, /* 2단계단가협의여부 */ PRICE_CONFIRM_REPL_FLAG = #{st_price_confirm_repl_flag}, /* 견적단가협의대행등록가능여부 */ ORDER_CONFIRM_FLAG = #{st_order_confirm_flag}, /* 2단계주문확정여부 */ ORDER_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG = #{st_order_dept_elctr_flag}, /* 주문부서전자결재여부 */ REQUEST_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG = #{st_request_dept_elctr_flag}, /* 의뢰부서전자결재여부 */ GR_REGIST_FLAG = #{st_gr_regist_flag}, /* 입고대행등록가능여부 */ AUTO_GR_FLAG = #{st_auto_gr_flag}, /* 삭제-자동입고여부 */ STD_DATE_FLAG = #{st_std_date_flag}, /* 표준납기관리여부 */ MULTI_QUOTATION_FLAG = #{st_multi_quotation_flag}, /* 복수협력사견적필수여부 */ STD_INVOICE_FLAG = #{st_std_invoice_flag}, /* kep표준거래명세서사용여부 */ FIVE_CATEG_FLAG = #{st_five_categ_flag}, /* 5단계카테고리 */ VAT_FLAG = #{st_vat_flag}, /* 부가세포함여부 */ CORP_REGIST_FLAG = #{st_corp_regist_flag}, SEAL_CERTI_REGIST_FLAG = #{st_seal_certi_regist_flag}, USE_SEAL_REGIST_FLAG = #{st_use_seal_regist_flag}, CONTRACT_REGIST_FLAG = #{st_contract_regist_flag} WHERE COM_CODE = #{com_code}

/*insertMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalKepBuyerFlag*/ INSERT INTO KEP_BUYER_FLAG ( COM_CODE, /* 고객사 코드 */ RCPT_PO_FLAG, /* 접수발주여부 */ FEE_BASE_FLAG, /* FEE방법거래여부 */ MNG_NO_FLAG, /* 관리번호사용여부 */ MNG_NO_POPUP_FLAG, /* 관리번호팝업사용여부 */ OFFICE_CATLG_FLAG, /* 사무용품카탈로그사용여부 */ BUYER_CATLG_EDIT_FLAG, /* 고객사카탈로그정비불가여부 */ QUOTATAION_EDIT_FLAG, /* 견적제출수정가능여부 */ NEW_ITEM_PM_FLAG, /* 신규상품견적의뢰결재상신여부 */ EXIST_ACT_FLAG, /* 삭제-기존매입대응불가여부 */ AUTO_CONFIRM_FLAG, /* 자동단가합의여부 */ QUOTATAION_BATCH_FLAG, /* 견적일괄제출여부 */ PRICE_CONFIRM_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 단가합의전자결재여부 */ STEP2_PRICE_FLAG, /* 2단계단가협의여부 */ PRICE_CONFIRM_REPL_FLAG, /* 견적단가협의대행등록가능여부 */ ORDER_CONFIRM_FLAG, /* 2단계주문확정여부 */ ORDER_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 주문부서전자결재여부 */ REQUEST_DEPT_ELCTR_FLAG, /* 의뢰부서전자결재여부 */ GR_REGIST_FLAG, /* 입고대행등록가능여부 */ AUTO_GR_FLAG, /* 삭제-자동입고여부 */ STD_DATE_FLAG, /* 표준납기관리여부 */ MULTI_QUOTATION_FLAG, /* 복수협력사견적필수여부 */ STD_INVOICE_FLAG, /* kep표준거래명세서사용여부 */ FIVE_CATEG_FLAG, /* 5단계카테고리 */ VAT_FLAG, /* 부가세포함여부 */ CORP_REGIST_FLAG, SEAL_CERTI_REGIST_FLAG, USE_SEAL_REGIST_FLAG, CONTRACT_REGIST_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{com_code}, #{st_rcpt_po_flag}, #{st_fee_base_flag}, #{st_mng_no_flag}, #{st_mng_no_popup_flag}, #{st_office_catlg_flag}, #{st_buyer_catlg_edit_flag}, #{st_quotataion_edit_flag}, #{st_new_item_pm_flag}, #{st_exist_act_flag}, #{st_auto_confirm_flag}, #{st_quotataion_batch_flag}, #{st_price_confirm_elctr_flag}, #{st_step2_price_flag}, #{st_price_confirm_repl_flag}, #{st_order_confirm_flag}, #{st_order_dept_elctr_flag}, #{st_request_dept_elctr_flag}, #{st_gr_regist_flag}, #{st_auto_gr_flag}, #{st_std_date_flag}, #{st_multi_quotation_flag}, #{st_std_invoice_flag}, #{st_five_categ_flag}, #{st_vat_flag}, #{st_corp_regist_flag}, #{st_seal_certi_regist_flag}, #{st_use_seal_regist_flag}, #{st_contract_regist_flag} )

INSERT INTO ICOMCMAU (COM_CODE, STATUS, MENU_ID, SEQ_NO) SELECT MIN(#{com_code}), MIN('C'), A.MENU_ID, MIN(B.SEQ_NO) FROM ICOMMENU A , ICOMCMAU B WHERE A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.COM_SECT ='B' AND A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID GROUP BY (A.MENU_ID)
INSERT INTO ACNTBUYR ( BUYER, SER_NO, PAY_TERMS, PAY_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{com_code}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(SER_NO)+1, 1) FROM ACNTBUYR WHERE BUYER = #{com_code}), #{st_pay_terms}, #{st_pay_type} )

/* insertMasterMdCtBuyerChargeEntryList */ INSERT INTO MIS_BUYER_MNG ( SEQ, YEAR, BUYER, KEP_DEPT, KEP_USER_ID, ITEM_GROUP, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, POSITION_GROUP, START_SCOPE, END_SCOPE, PRIORITY, STATUS ) VALUES ( NVL((SELECT MAX(SEQ)+1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR=#{YEAR} AND BUYER=#{COM_CODE} AND KEP_DEPT=#{KEP_DEPT} AND ITEM_GROUP='M'),1), #{YEAR}, #{COM_CODE}, #{KEP_DEPT}, #{KEP_USER_ID}, 'M', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{POSITION_GROUP}, 0, 10000000000, DECODE(#{PRIORITY}, '1', 'Y', ''), 'C' )
mapper.select: /* getMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalKepBuyerRate */ SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE WHERE BUYER = #{com_code} AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalKepBuyerRate */ INSERT INTO KEP_BUYER_RATE ( BUYER, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, RATE, RATE_GUBUN, CONTRACT_FLAG, RATE_EDIT_FLAG, CREATE_USER_ID, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{com_code}, REPLACE(#{st_from_date}, '/',''), REPLACE(#{st_to_date}, '/',''), #{st_rate}, #{st_rate_gubun}, #{st_contract_flag}, #{st_rate_edit_flag}, #{st_user_id}, SYSDATE )

/* updateMasterMdCtBuyerJoinAlterRequestApprovalKepBuyerRate */ UPDATE KEP_BUYER_RATE SET FROM_DATE = REPLACE(#{st_from_date}, '/', ''), TO_DATE = REPLACE(#{st_to_date}, '/', ''), RATE = #{st_rate}, RATE_GUBUN = #{st_rate_gubun}, CONTRACT_FLAG = #{st_contract_flag}, RATE_EDIT_FLAG = #{st_rate_edit_flag}, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #{com_code} AND FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') AND TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM KX_USERAUTH WHERE USER_ID = UPPER(#{buyer_user_id})
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KX_USERAUTH ( USER_ID, AUTH_ID, CREATE_DT, USE_FLAG ) VALUES ( UPPER(#{buyer_user_id}), #{st_auth_id}, SYSDATE, 'Y' )
UPDATE KX_USERAUTH SET AUTH_ID = #{st_auth_id}, USE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = UPPER(#{buyer_user_id})
mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtSgMarginList */ SELECT B.CODE1 AS BUYER , A.SG_ID , A.SG_NAME , B.TEXT1 AS MARGIN , (SELECT MAX(USR.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMCOD3 COD, ICOMLUSR USR WHERE COD.TYPE ='CMSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = USR.USER_ID AND COD.CODE1 = A.SG_ID AND COD.TEXT2 = 'Y') AS SG_SM_NM , (SELECT MAX(USR.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMCOD3 COD, ICOMLUSR USR WHERE COD.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = USR.USER_ID AND COD.CODE1 = A.SG_ID AND COD.TEXT2 = 'Y') AS SG_DSM_NM FROM KEPSGMG A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE A.SG_ID = B.CODE2(+) AND B.BUYER (+)= 'KRKORE0001' AND B.CODE1 (+)= #{com_code} AND B.TYPE (+)= 'CMSG' AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.FLAG (+)= 'Y' ORDER BY SG_ID

/*selectMasterMdCtCod3SgMarginList*/ SELECT COD.BUYER ,COD.TYPE ,COD.CODE1 ,COD.CODE2 ,COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMSG' AND COD.CODE1 = #{com_code} AND COD.CODE2 = #{SG_ID}
